title: a labelled picture: find the part
seam: each part of the picture (the drawn shape itself, the whole part is the target): data-part="<key>"
each part's name: data-label="<key>" placed beside its part, with a short leader line to it
brief: KIND: diagram. A clear, friendly picture of Studio.params.subject with its parts (Studio.params.parts), each part a separate shape, each named with its string next to it.

QUESTION: ask (find the part named Studio.params.ask). The child taps a part -> Studio.answer("<part key>"); feedback from Studio.onVerdict; on wrong the child can tap again; on correct the part glows and Studio.done().
Before the answer every part is drawn in its natural colour with no highlight.
antiPatterns: a label far from its part or pointing at another part
the asked part highlighted before the tap
tiny parts that cannot be tapped
